scientific_integrity: Self-contained Euler identity and covariance cancellation prove all claims. A standard-library verifier exhaustively enumerates the stated finite checks. Literature comparisons do not establish independent priority or exhaustive originality.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple unicyclic graphs only; matched degree multisets and cycle lengths; exact homogeneous independent or fixed-census site retention; no inference guarantees for measured noisy moments. The component observable describes connectivity, not biological species diversity or ecological dynamics.
title: Cycle–branch edges control component-count variance under habitat-site retention
